These are analyst-owned long-running research threads. Each thesis is a living document — the analyst's evolving synthesis of accumulated research discussion, fact-check, mailbox, and operator-action material. Use this to - avoid re-deriving conclusions another analyst is actively building - weight your own claims against an established thesis (especially when it disagrees) - cite the project thesis directly when its conclusion is load-bearing, rather than re-running a web search

Identify small banks with false CET1 comfort

Owner: financials-analyst · Thesis v5 · Ticks: 3 · Materials: 55 · Deadline: 12d left · project_id: rp_7dc1abe8773c4cdf

Kickoff: Track city and rural commercial banks whose reported CET1 ratios look stable because asset shrink reduces the denominator while LGFV NPL migration, storage carry, and profit compression erode actual loss-absorption capacity. This matters because headline capital ratios may mask a slow credit-supply freeze and internal capital loss.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when a bank-level bridge decomposes CET1 movement into asset shrink, NPL migration, provision pressure, and profit retention, and classifies which small banks have genuine capital resilience versus false CET1 comfort.

Working hypothesis: A subset of small banks will show optically stable CET1 despite deteriorating economic capital because denominator shrinkage is offsetting unrecognized asset-quality and earnings stress.

1. 当前判断

当前证据支持“假CET1舒适区”框架：弱区域城农商行可能以缩表压低RWA、维持表观CET1，但LGFV净融资收缩、利差方差放大与NIM低位共同侵蚀真实吸损能力evidence refevidence ref[thesis:th_p_3caf37b8]。真韧性更可能来自存款特许权、稳定拨备前利润和可持续留存，而非单纯破净或资本率稳定；这强化“质量红利银行超配、非泛银行beta”的判断evidence ref

Thesis refresh: 锂电/储能：被反复打脸的 whipsaw 线，收敛为“三条件触底”框架

Owner: materials-analyst · Thesis v15 · Ticks: 9 · Materials: 73 · Deadline: 3d left · project_id: rp_6908ca9ebcae4ebe

Kickoff: Auto-derived from the thesis ledger: "锂电/储能：被反复打脸的 whipsaw 线，收敛为“三条件触底”框架" (th_T17, status=revised) has no new evidence for 9d. One line: 同一条链在 10 周内经历“供给反转（4/22）→周期寻底反方（4/23）→回避带（5/5）→底部上移+‘跌破10万’证伪（5/4，现货 17.7 万）→再度崩至 15.0 万且 2026 储能装机预测转负（6/26）”——机构教训固化为三条件右侧框架。. Research the current state — does the latest data confirm, contradict, or revise it?

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when new dated evidence for th_T17 lands in thesis_evidence (the ledger's last_evidence_at advances past this goal's creation).

1. 当前判断

对 th_T17 的刷新结论是“修订而非确认触底”：7/24 电池级碳酸锂 14.55 万元/吨已跌破 15 万重置线，旧价格底被证伪，但 6 月动力装车 76.5GWh、同比 +31.5% 与上半年 +12.0% 又否定需求单边塌陷[web:turn0search0][web:turn1search0]。储能侧更像“量有支撑、利润和收益机制未闭环”：2026 中国新型储能累计预测 185-195GW、全国储能 136GW/351GWh/均时 2.58h，与已知 +41% 增长观点同向，但并网、调度和容量补偿仍限制向锂盐价格传导[web:turn0search2]evidence ref[mailbox_thread:[source-id-redacted]]。因此三条件右侧框架应改为“价格重新站稳 15 万上方+库存/供给纪律确认+储能收益兑现”同现，单一装机或政策信号只够中性观察，不构成右侧买点evidence ref。

2026-07-29 · 家装链从新房beta切换到存量翻新/出海

Owner: realestate-analyst · Final thesis v12 · Ticks: 8 · project_id: rp_0f8a8b0d99ed46d3

家装链从新房beta切换到存量翻新/出海 — Final Report

Kickoff: 跟踪家装产业链中高零售占比、低房企应收、进入以旧换新补贴范围或具备非美大宗出口壁垒的公司，验证其是否能在竣工下行背景下把存量房翻新、智能/适老化升级和出海通道转化为订单与现金流。该判断关系到家装链是否应从地产下行空头重新定价为结构性alpha。

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when two consecutive reporting periods show either (a) tracked names' renovation/export-driven orders and operating cash flow both improve despite continued weak completions, confirming the thesis, or (b) orders or operating cash flow fail to improve after subsidy/export channels remain available, invalidating the thesis.

Working hypothesis: 家装主驱动已由新房竣工beta转向存量房翻新、以旧换新补贴和出海；超额收益集中在零售化、现金创造强、低房企应收的细分龙头，而工程重和补贴排除品类是陷阱。
